name: openhands-runtime
notes: Run scripts/vendor-openhands.sh to resolve ref to an exact commit and populate commit_sha/image_tag.
source_dir 'vendor/openhands' is an optional local checkout and is not populated in this repository; commit_sha stays null until vendor-openhands.sh runs.
vendor/openhands-sdk/ is a separate, committed tree containing the upstream OpenHands software-agent-sdk source.
Run scripts/build-openhands-local.sh after vendoring to build the local runtime image.
Do not use floating public images such as ghcr.io/all-hands-ai/openhands:latest for production execution.
